payout_quote: The time commitment is 7-11 hours over the span of multiple visits. Compensation is $10 per hour, and $50 for an MRI visit, up to $200 total.
steps: Open the KU Life Span Institute 'Participants Needed for Brain Research' page
Confirm eligibility: ages 5-35 (minors participate with families)
Fill out the linked study inquiry form (redcap.kumc.edu) or email brainlab@ku.edu / call 785-864-4461
Complete cognitive and motor tasks plus brain anatomy/function tests (including possible MRI) across multiple visits, 7-11 hours total
Receive $10/hour plus $50 for an MRI visit, up to $200 total
catches: Up to $200 total; typical pay is $10/hour — the full $200 requires the MRI visit and ~11 hours
7-11 hours of active participation across multiple in-person visits at KU
Ages 5-35; a minor participates via family
Health screening per KU guidelines before in-person meetings
biggest_catch: Earning the full $200 requires the full 7-11 hours including an MRI visit ($50) across multiple in-person visits.
eligibility: Ages 5-35; health screening required before in-person visits.
timing: 7-11 hours over multiple visits; payment timing not stated on the page.
